questions.question: Pqr ranked 71st from the bottom and 39th from the top in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Rank of **Pqr** from the **top** = 39th

Rank of **Pqr** from the **bottom** = 71st

**Total number of students** in the class = Rank from the top + Rank from the bottom − 1

= 39 + 71 − 1

= 110 − 1

= 109

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

18, 200

17, 189
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Second Number = (First Number × 11) + 2**

For the first set **18, 200**

⇒ (18 × 11) + 2

⇒ 198 + 2 = 200.

For the second set **17, 189**

⇒ (17 × 11) + 2

⇒ 187 + 2 = 189.

Applying the same logic to the options:

For **Option 1: 19, 211**

⇒ (19 × 11) + 2

⇒ 209 + 2 = 211.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

558 × 31 − 18 ÷ 17 + 321 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

According to the question, the signs are interchanged as follows:

__
 
• **‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.**
 
• **‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.**

Given equation: 558 × 31 − 18 ÷ 17 + 321 = ?

After interchanging the signs, using the BODMAS rule the new equation is:

**= 558 ÷ 31 + 18 × 17 − 321**

= 18 + 18 × 17__ − 321 

**= **18 + 306 − 321 

**= **324 − 321

= 3

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 1"**

questions.question: All 145 people are standing in a row facing north. Ccd is 24th from the right end while Vks is 26th from the left end. How many people are there between Ccd and Vks?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Total number of people in the row = 145
 
• Position of **Vks** from the left end = 26th
 
• Position of **Ccd** from the right end = 24th

Number of people between **Ccd** and **Vks** = Total number of people − (Position of **Vks** from the left + Position of **Ccd** from the right)

= 145 − (26 + 24)

= 145 − 50

= 95

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
